purpose: Define concrete exact review-coordinate placement requirements for the true-to-life Manhattan Ave / Greenpoint Ave MVP scene.

coordinateSpace.meaning: Exact review-coordinate placement on the MVP plate. This is not a GIS/survey transform and not a public/product exact-geometry claim.

buildingMass.notes: Human-prepared scene envelope aligned to the current raster plate and hotspot context.

frontageSegment.notes: Estimated storefront-facing segment for QA generation, not exact frontage/order.

storefrontSample.notes: Human-prepared storefront sample aligned to the raster plate for proof-of-concept generation.

addressAnchor.notes: Estimated scene anchor from address context and current composition; exact address placement remains blocked.

entranceGeometry.notes: Exact door/entrance geometry is blocked; rendered only as a QA blocked cue.

facadePlaceholder.notes: Facade panel is generated from the human-prepared storefront sample for QA visibility only.

visibleSceneRequirements: Place the named storefront in its committed corner and review-coordinate storefront bounds.
Use the frontage segment as the required MVP review frontage line on the plate.
Place address anchor at the review-coordinate point but label it review geometry until source projection is automatic.
Use supplied reference photos to derive facade order, sign band, entrance, and window requirements for the next generated raster pass.
Preserve truth labels for source-backed, photo-derived, manual review-only, and unresolved fields.
visualPlacementRequirements.nextDataMove: Create an exact-geometry override row in a review-only scene fixture with fields for frontageLine, storefrontBounds, entranceBounds, windowBounds, signBounds, sourceCategory, and confidence.

visibleSceneRequirements: Place a Greenpoint G subway cue at the committed review-coordinate center and entrance bounds.
Use supplied station/context reference photos to verify cue orientation before any stronger exact station entrance claim.

rasterGenerationRequirements: The next raster attempt should consume target-scene-spec visualPlacementRequirements rather than freeform prose.
Each rendered facade element must carry sourceCategory and status in a companion provenance map.
The generated scene must preserve real target names and address context without ratings, reviews, hours, endorsements, partnership, or promotional claims.
No generated image may be called production art or public factual representation.

candidateNextImplementationBatch.recommended: Create a review-only exact-geometry scene fixture and generator adapter that consumes this spec to produce a structured raster prompt/provenance packet, then optionally a true regenerated raster image pass if Batu accepts the target scene spec.
